entries.note: Chinese wording 快件电子信息已经收到. The waybill's information reached YITU, before it has the parcel.
Chinese wording 快件到达作业中心. "The parcel reached the operations centre": the first scan, at YITU's site in Yiwu.
Chinese wording 快件操作完成. "Handling of the parcel is complete"; it leaves the site.
"The parcel reached the operations centre", without a code: a later centre on the way, after the first scan.
"Handling of the parcel is complete", without a code: it leaves a later centre.
